title: Run agent (prompt)
text: The Flutter action trims input and applies a synchronous duplicate-submit lock.
explanation: The server validates independently. The lock applies before awaiting any network operation.

title: POST /api/agent/stream
code:
final request = http.Request('POST', endpoint('/api/agent/stream'))
  ..headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
  ..body = jsonEncode({'prompt': prompt});
final response = await client
text: The Dart client posts a JSON prompt to the stream endpoint.
explanation: Production uses same-origin URLs. Development explicitly points to FastAPI on port 8300, which allows only the two local frontend origins.

title: Validate; tools disabled
text: A strict Pydantic model trims the string and checks its bounds.
explanation: The ASGI boundary first checks actual bytes, Origin and content type. SDK options separately disable built-in tools.

title: stream_agent() / query()
code:
async with aclosing(agent.stream_agent(body.prompt)) as messages:
    async for message in messages:
        yield ServerSentEvent(event='message', data=message)
yield ServerSentEvent(event='done', data={'status': 'complete'})
text: FastAPI delegates execution to the Python agent service.
explanation: The server owns configuration and credentials. The generator scope closes the SDK iterator on completion or cancellation.

title: Prompt; no built-in tools
text: The actual SDK query boundary owns the CLI runtime and model transport.
explanation: Application code supplies a prompt/options and observes SDK messages. The model HTTP exchange itself is internal to the SDK.

title: Model response
text: Async iteration observes SDK messages until a final result appears.
explanation: The same small loop as the terminal lesson remains recognizable. Streaming projects intermediate messages while query mode returns a final answer.

title: Safe SDK message
text: Only allowlisted SDK projections leave the service.
explanation: Projection branches above this yield include text, system subtype and final metrics. Thinking, environment, tools and session IDs are excluded.

title: SSE message event
code:
yield ServerSentEvent(event='message', data=message)
yield ServerSentEvent(event='done', data={'status': 'complete'})
text: FastAPI serializes a safe SDK projection into a native SSE frame.
explanation: EventSourceResponse handles heartbeat comments and disconnect cancellation. The route applies a three-minute execution deadline.

title: Update typed state
text: Each received SDK message updates Flutter state.
explanation: The visible timeline is bounded. Final-result processing continues after 500 displayed rows. State belongs to this application instance.

title: ResultMessage fields
text: Normalize answer, turns, duration, estimated cost and SDK error status.
explanation: Exact key occurrences are redacted. Non-success subtypes stay failures; an unreported cost remains null.

title: SSE ResultMessage
text: The Dart client runtime-validates every message and final result.
explanation: ResultMessage is a safe public projection. The application receives it in the same SSE message event as progress.

explanation: No model HTML is inserted into the DOM or executed. Remote answer images are omitted and links are limited to HTTP(S). The pre builder colors fenced code.

title: SSE done event
text: Require both a final result and the terminal done event.
explanation: The parser preserves split UTF-8, CRLF and multiline data. Completing the transport does not override a failed SDK result.

title: SSE error; no done
text: A provider failure after SSE starts emits a safe error without done.
explanation: Query mode instead returns safe HTTP 502. Raw provider exceptions and submitted values are excluded.

title: Error + snackbar
text: Flutter shows the safe API error and a snackbar, then restores controls.
explanation: Specific validation/key errors survive the client boundary. Other network failures use a readable fallback; timers stop in finally.

title: Key: SSE error / input: 422
text: A missing key stops execution before the SDK is called.
explanation: Query returns HTTP 503; stream sends error without done. Invalid inputs are rejected before route execution. Neither path spends model credits.
